# errors/from_pagination_role_rejected_on_next_url_in_body — slice 4 deleted
# the {from_pagination: <role>} discriminator; the cursor-namespace validator
# now catches templates that ref a cursor field next_url_in_body doesn't
# register (next_url_in_body only provides cursor.next_url).

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
stdout 'cursor field "token" is not provided by the active pagination/progress strategy'

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"
auth:
  none: {}
requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events
    query:
      tok: {ref: cursor.token}
response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events
pagination:
  next_url_in_body:
    next_url_at: response.body.meta.next
progress:
  stateless: {}
